Help turn AI opportunities into real business value. If you enjoy partnering with stakeholders, solving business challenges through technology, and bringing AI solutions from idea to impact, this is an opportunity to combine business engagement, solution design and delivery in a role at the centre of our AI transformation.

Meet your future team

You will join the Data & AI Platforms team, where we work to accelerate the adoption of AI across the organisation through a federated delivery model. Business functions own their priorities and outcomes, while this team provides expertise, standards and delivery capabilities to help turn ideas into scalable solutions.

As an AI Solutions Partner, you will act as the bridge between business and technology. You will partner closely with leaders and stakeholders across your assigned business areas, helping them identify opportunities, shape solutions and realise value through AI. Working alongside Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Platform Engineers, you will guide AI use cases from discovery and design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining business understanding, technology expertise and stakeholder engagement to drive meaningful outcomes.

What We Offer

As an AI Solutions Partner, you will own the end-to-end journey of AI use cases within your business areas. You will help shape the AI agenda, drive delivery and ensure solutions create measurable value.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Partner with business leaders to identify, prioritise and deliver high-value AI use cases.

• Translate business opportunities and challenges into AI solutions, including agents, GenAI applications, automations and custom-built products.

• Lead AI initiatives from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, adoption and value realisation.

• Define data and semantic requirements and collaborate closely with Data Engineering and Data & AI Platform teams to deliver scalable solutions.

• Contribute hands-on where needed through prototyping, configuration, prompt engineering and development of reusable components.

• Drive stakeholder alignment, change management and adoption to maximise business impact.

• Communicate progress, outcomes and realised value to senior stakeholders and represent your business areas within the AI CoE.

• Feed insights and platform requirements back to engineering teams to help continuously improve shared capabilities and tooling.

What You Will Bring

You are naturally curious about how technology can solve business challenges and create value. You are equally comfortable discussing strategy with business stakeholders and working with technical teams to shape and deliver solutions.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Have experience delivering Data, Analytics or AI solutions in a business environment.

• Bring a strong technical foundation and understanding of modern cloud, data and analytics platforms.

• Have knowledge of Generative AI, LLM-based solutions and emerging AI technologies.

• Possess strong solution design and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable solutions.

• Have experience working closely with stakeholders and navigating priorities, processes, budgets and change initiatives.

• Are an excellent communicator who can build relationships across both business and technical communities.

• Thrive in collaborative and cross-functional environments.

• Take a pragmatic and value-focused approach to delivery.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

In the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**Job Description Summary

**As a Service Account Leader at GE HealthCare, you will play a key role in growing our service business across Denmark. By building trusted customer relationships and delivering innovative lifecycle solutions, you will help healthcare providers maximize equipment uptime, optimize operational performance, and deliver exceptional patient care.

Working closely with local sales and service teams, you will identify new business opportunities, develop strategic service offerings, and drive sustainable growth across our Imaging, Ultrasound, and Patient Care Solutions portfolio. The role combines commercial leadership, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic international environment.

**Responsibilities

****Job Description

**

• Sell point-of-sale service contracts and solutions while protecting margin by communicating value and maintaining pricing discipline.

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of GE HealthCare’s service solutions and relevant competitive offerings.

• Develop account penetration strategies for key target accounts and competitive accounts. Share market intelligence, field concerns, emerging issues, and customer requirements with the wider business.

• Lead customer negotiations and close deals by engaging key buying stakeholders, including technical and biomedical personnel, department heads, and C-suite executives.

• Achieve annual and quarterly revenue targets by maintaining accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts, prioritizing selling time effectively, increasing sales volume, deepening account penetration, and ensuring comprehensive territory coverage.

• Maintain strong after-sales relationships, develop long-term customer partnerships, and identify opportunities that address both immediate and evolving customer needs.

**Qualifications/Requirements

**

• At least one of the following core experiences:

• Consultative sales or marketing experience, including strategic selling and negotiation in a complex sales environment involving multiple decision-makers and influencers.

• Healthcare service experience, preferably in Diagnostic Imaging, Ultrasound, or Patient Care Solutions.

• Experience in one or more customer-facing roles.

• Excellent written and spoken Danish and English language skills.

• Willingness to travel within the assigned geographic region.

**Desired Skills

**

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Previous Healthcare sales experience.

• Robust interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to work independently as well as with a team.

• Strong written and verbal communication and clear thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex issues into simple messages.

• Solid process orientation, demonstrated resource management and allocation experience, and the ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.

• Experience interfacing with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution-based sales process.

**Inclusion and Diversity

**GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

**Behaviours

**We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

**Total Rewards

**Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions that help our customers decarbonize while staying resilient and competitive. Our Controls and Thermal Management division combines heat exchanger expertise with technologies for refrigeration, cooling and air conditioning, serving customers across HVAC, refrigeration and industrial applications.

In this role, you’ll lead our European Sales team for Brazed, Gasketed and Welded Heat Exchangers and play a key role in accelerating growth across both existing customers and new markets.

Your impact? You’ll shape and execute our European sales strategy, strengthen how we go to market, and continue the transformation toward a modern, data-driven sales organization with customer experience at its core.

Working closely with regional and global stakeholders, you’ll combine commercial leadership, market insights and strong customer engagement to turn opportunities into sustainable business growth.

We would prefer you to be located close to one of our main hubs in Kolding, Denmark, Kamnik, Slovenia, or Hamburg, Germany. Remote work may be considered for the right candidate, and we are open to supporting relocation.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead, develop and empower a European team of technical sales engineers and business developers to deliver sustainable sales growth.

• Shape and execute sales plans based on market insights, customer buying behavior and business priorities, working closely with regional and global stakeholders.

• Develop existing accounts and turn new leads, markets and customer opportunities into business growth.

• Build strong customer relationships through regular market engagement, identifying customer needs and demonstrating the value of our products and solutions.

• Drive a disciplined, data-driven sales approach through consistent use of CRM, forecasting and sales processes to support agile decision-making.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or equivalent knowledge and experience, combined with significant experience in sales, engineering or business development.

• Strong commercial and strategic capabilities, with the ability to analyze markets, competitors and opportunities and translate insights into effective business strategies.

• Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage customers, partners and diverse internal stakeholders.

• Knowledge of HVAC and/or industrial applications and markets, supported by solid analytical capabilities.

• A flexible and resourceful approach to changing market conditions, with the ability to navigate challenges and identify opportunities for growth.

The role requires approximately 20–40% travel, primarily within Europe.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about. We think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

jobs.description:
About Cardlay
Cardlay is a Danish fintech building white-label card and spend management solutions. Banks, issuers and financial partners in Europe and the US offer our platform to their business customers using their own brand.

We are a small dedicated team with short decision paths. We make bold decisions, turn them into results by helping each other, and give people the mandate to own what they build.
About the job
Our web portal is where companies run their spend: cards, expenses, accounting and people management. Every bank offers it under its own brand.

Some of the core capabilities include

• Cards: card programs, card orders and requests, and funding accounts
• Expenses: transactions, receipts, mileages and expense policies
• Accounting: categories, cost dimensions, GL accounts and exports to external accounting systems
• People and teams: onboarding, invitations, roles and company settings
Under the hood, it's React, TypeScript, pnpm workspaces and Vite.

Every new bank brings its own brand and requirements, and AI agents now write a growing share of our code. We need a senior engineer who builds the product and keeps the shared components and patterns behind them consistent, so new screens, whether built by people or AI agents, look and work like the rest of the product.

This is a hands-on product role with significant ownership: you will build features every day and help set our frontend direction.

What success looks like after a year

• Customers use features you built and shipped end to end
• A new feature takes less code and fewer review rounds than it does today
• New screens are built from shared components by default, by people and AI agents alike
• The core libraries are up to date with latest security updates and we are on a clear upgrade path going forward
The challenge

Customers rely on the platform every day, and it has grown over several years:

• Some pages use our new design system and some don't yet. Deciding what to migrate, and when, to keep the experience consistent is ongoing work
• You work closely with our UI/UX Lead. That takes the confidence to push back on designs that hurt the user experience, and the taste to know when you're right
• There are several ways of handling data and state in the codebase, and picking the right one for each case directly affects what customers experience
• We're a small team, and other developers contribute a lot to the web portal. As the senior frontend engineer, you decide what's good enough to merge and where our code style and stack go next
• You look beyond your own domain. When the answer is on the other side of the API, you read the backend code and unblock yourself where you canWhat you'll do
As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will own the frontend of our web portal. You take responsibility for what we ship, make decisions others can build on, drive projects forward and help the people around you grow.

You will be the primary frontend engineer in an engineering team of 10 people across frontend, backend, mobile and DevOps. You will work closely with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and report to our Head of Engineering.

Your responsibilities will include

• Take responsibility for the frontend as a whole: its quality, performance and direction
• Make the key frontend decisions and stand by them: architecture, what goes into the design system and when to say no
• Drive projects from idea to production with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and own them until customers are using them
• Build reusable components and patterns as part of your product work, not one-off solutions
• Move legacy screens onto the design system as you work on them, without silent visual regressions
• Set up component APIs, lint rules and docs so AI agents produce code that fits
• Mentor other engineers and share what you know through reviews, docs and pairingWho you are
We are looking for an experienced frontend engineer who loves building a product and cares about the quality and consistency behind it.

You likely bring

• Deep experience with React and TypeScript
• You have shipped complex features in a web product that customers rely on
• You use AI coding tools every day and know where they go wrong
• A good eye for UX and product quality
• You speak up when something could be done better, and you see your work through to production
• You have driven projects with other engineers and helped them grow through mentoring and reviews
Bonus if you have

• Experience building component libraries or design systems
• Design tokens or white-label theming
• Interest in fullstack work, so you can help out on the backend when you can
• Experience from fintech or complex B2B products
You will work with the technologies below. We don't expect experience with all of them; we are looking for engineers who learn quickly.

• React, TypeScript
• Vite, pnpm workspaces, Biome
• MUI, styled-components, Storybook
• TanStack Query, TanStack Table, Redux Toolkit
• React Hook Form, react-intl
• Vitest, MSW, CypressWhy Cardlay
You will join at a point where our platform is proven, our customer base is growing and AI is changing how we build software. You will have a real say in how Cardlay builds the frontend, in a team where senior engineers set the direction.

• Permanent employment, freelance or consultancy, with salary or rate matching experience
• Hybrid work from our offices in Copenhagen or Odense
• English as our main working language, with Danish spoken too. You don't need to speak Danish to join
• Flexible working hours, and the option to work from home when it suits you and the team
• Company-paid phone and home internet
• Lunch, coffee, fruit, drinks and snacks at the officeHow to apply
Go ahead and hit "apply" and upload your résumé, application and other relevant information through our HR system.

Any questions about the position can be directed to our Head of Engineering:

Magnus Biolzi Hansen, Mail: mbh@cardlay.com, Telephone: +45 42 28 62 42

Application deadline: We review applications as they come in and will close the position once we've found the right person.

You are most likely a technically strong tax professional with a hands on approach. You will have a broad operational responsibility with a strong focus on Danish corporate income tax within a joint taxation group, Direct Tax across the group and an interest in tax digitalisation.

• Responsibility for Danish corporate income tax compliance, including joint taxation (sambeskatning)

• Preparation and review of tax calculations and tax returns

• Participation in dialogue with tax authorities, including audits and enquiries

• Monitoring tax legislation and assessing impacts on the group

• Contributing to process optimisation, automation, digitalisation and development of tax governance

• Acting as a sparring partner to finance functions and other stakeholders in the organisation

• Contribution to transfer pricing compliance and documentation

Your profile

You Likely Have

• Experience working with multinational organisations and shared service centers is considered an advantage

• A structured and analytical mindset with attention to detail

• The ability to work independently while being a strong team player

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly

• Fluent in Danish and English (written and spoken).

The team and working environment

You will join a dedicated Global Tax team with high professional standards and a pragmatic, solution oriented mindset. We work closely together across tax disciplines and value trust, openness and knowledge sharing.

The position is based at our office in Randers, offering flexible working conditions.

Why join us?

We offer an exciting and visible role in a complex international group undergoing transformation.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

• Work with a broad tax scope and real business impact

• Develop your technical and professional skills in close collaboration with experienced colleagues

• Being part of a company that values trust, openness and personal development

• Enjoy attractive employment conditions, including a competitive salary, pension and health insurance

Interested?

If you are motivated by responsibility, complexity and collaboration, we would be pleased to hear from you. If you have any questions about the role, please contact Director, Head of Global Tax, Merete Rousing Glob at +45 41 15 55 10.

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

At Gram Equipment, we develop and deliver equipment for industrial ice cream production worldwide. We are looking for a Marine and Technical Engineering student (maskinmester) or a student from a similar technical programme to join our On-site team in Kolding for an internship in spring 2027.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues and gain insight into how we prepare and coordinate installation and commissioning activities at customer sites. Along the way, you will learn how technical requirements, planning and collaboration across departments contribute to getting equipment ready for production.
What you will be doing
You will support our On-site team in their daily work, with tasks adapted to your skills, interests and study requirements. Your tasks may include:

• Supporting the planning and preparation of installation and commissioning activities.
• Preparing and updating technical documentation, checklists and progress reports.
• Participating in coordination meetings and following up on agreed actions.
• Helping coordinate activities across On-site, Project Management, Engineering and Service.
• Supporting the follow-up on technical questions and outstanding issues.
• Collecting feedback from installation projects and contributing ideas to improve processes and ways of working.
As you develop your understanding of our equipment and working methods, you will have the opportunity to take responsibility for defined tasks with guidance from the team.

You are studying Marine and Technical Engineering (maskinmester), Mechanical Engineering or a related technical programme. You have an interest in industrial equipment and are curious about how mechanical, electrical and automation systems work together in practice.

We also imagine that you:

• Are eager to apply your technical knowledge and learn from experienced colleagues.
• Work in a structured way and follow through on your tasks.
• Enjoy collaborating with people across different functions.
• Take initiative and ask questions when you need input.
• Communicate clearly in English, both spoken and written.
You do not need previous experience with installation or commissioning. What matters is your willingness to learn and contribute.
What we offer
You will gain practical experience in an international engineering company, with support and feedback from experienced colleagues. You will work on tasks connected to real projects and develop your technical understanding and coordination skills.

Our main office in Kolding offers an informal working environment with dedicated colleagues.

The internship will take place in spring 2027. We will agree on the start date, duration, scope and learning objectives in line with your study programme.

The internship will also involve travel to customer sites, giving you the opportunity to experience installation and commissioning activities first-hand alongside experienced colleagues.

We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

usual; to be remarkable; proudly unique and authentic

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers an opportunity to develop beyond inspection readiness. You will work closely with the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and support selected functional initiatives, providing exposure to broader activities across the organization and our CMO and vendor network. In parallel, you will have the opportunity to build your GMP and clinical supply knowledge by learning and supporting selected operational activities related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

The position reports to the Director, Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing based in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing with selected functional initiatives and tasks across the organization.

• Support activities related to our external CMO and vendor network, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Build knowledge of GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and learn and support selected operational tasks related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible to be compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

Requirements

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GMP and GCP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including CMOs and vendors.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

The Team

You will be part of a highly competent team focused on GMP applicable to packaging and labelling of supplies for clinical trials, with a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness and successful collaboration with our internal stakeholders and CMOs.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Portfolio & Project Delivery and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department.

We have an international and informal working environment with a high pace, strong one-team spirit and close collaboration across functions.

Application

Has this sparked your interest? Then we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter including your motivation for this position. We screen candidates on a continuous basis and call in for interviews.

Fully remote applicants will not be considered, so please indicate if you are willing to relocate if you’re not currently living in commute distance.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Life as a consultant is different from a typical in-house role. At the Tech Collective, consulting means working on a wide range of projects with various clients – so you'll regularly encounter new challenges and have plenty of opportunities to grow your skills quickly.

We believe AI and agentic coding accelerate great developer practices – they do not replace them. That’s why solid architecture, quality, security, maintainability, and sound technical judgement matter more than ever.

In this senior role, you’ll help us understand client needs and turn them into real outcomes by taking technical ownership, guiding teams, and delivering robust solutions from idea to production.

• 
Build, test, and deliver software using modern engineering practices such as everything-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, automation, and open-source principles

Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them make great decisions and turn ideas into practical solutions

• 
Work across frontend and backend technologies, taking part in architectural decisions, system design, containerised environments, and clear, maintainable documentation

Improve developer and user experience by shifting quality left, applying strong design principles, mentoring others, and delivering minimum viable products with a clear path to scale

• 
Design, build, and operate platforms and infrastructure, including APIs, CLIs, platform engineering, immutable infrastructure, and internal developer platforms

Collaborate, teach, and lead through effective communication, technical writing, code reviews, lean principles, and strong data and security practices

Lead technical workstreams and collaborate closely with clients, translating business needs into pragmatic technical solutions

What you’ll bring

One thing that can be said of all your future colleagues is that we’re curious by nature, have a team-first mindset, a good sense of humour, and clear opinions on how tech can create value for our clients. If this sounds like you, you’ll be a great fit at The Tech Collective.

We’re looking for people with a relevant M.Sc. (this is mandatory and could be, for example, in computer science or software engineering) who are based within commuting distance of our office in Copenhagen.

We’re looking for someone with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development or similar engineering roles.

On top of that, the ideal candidate is someone who brings senior engineering experience and:

• 
Communicates clearly in both written and spoken English

• 
Shares our values around software quality and delivery

• 
Enjoys working closely with clients and building trusted relationships with them

• 
Is tool-agnostic and chooses the right tool for the job

• 
Is comfortable with complexity and able to break problems down into manageable pieces

• 
Has solid experience building and operating modern software systems in production

• 
Understands software architecture, system design, testing, security, and maintainability

• 
Can guide technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and communicate trade-offs clearly

• 
Has experience mentoring or supporting other developers through code reviews, pairing, or technical sparring

Please note that you don’t need to meet all the criteria. The most important thing is that you have an engineering foundation, a senior mindset, consulting skills and curiosity to keep learning and growing.

What we offer

When you step into our office, you step into a world of nerdery – and we love it and intend to keep it that way. You’ll become part of a low-ego, high-trust team of sharp engineers who you’ll work closely with from day one.

Working with us means:

• 
Real autonomy, real impact: you’ll own features end to end and lean into the tech you care most about.

Growth that matters: a learning programme, mentoring, and plenty of peer knowledge sharing.

Community and craft: strategy trips, meetups, and events across The Tech Collective/Implement Consulting Group.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Are you inspired by working in a company with ambitious goals? Our vision is that by 2030, Genmab’s knock-your-socks-off “KYSO” antibody medicines will be transforming the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases.

**The Role and Department

**Genmab's QC lab in Ballerup is growing in activities and we are now looking for an Associate Director of QC Support to join our team onsite in Ballerup.

The Associate Director of QC Support, Laboratory Systems and Equipment will be heading up the system team and equipment team, with the main purpose of supporting Genmab's QC operations within early- and late-phase as well as commercial products.

As a key member of the local QC leadership team, you will help shape and build a future-ready QC organization, ensuring scalable, innovative, and inspection-ready capabilities that enable accelerated development, successful product launches, and robust lifecycle management.

The role combines strategic leadership and transformation as a critical business enabler through digitalization, advanced analytics, and modern analytical technologies.

The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency-oriented direction. We expect you to be ambitious, motivated, self-driven, and to be able to make your colleagues shine in an environment of respectful and flexible collaboration.

You will be joining a team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory.

You will report to the Senior Director, Quality Control Lab.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build and lead the E-System Team providing business understanding, clear priorities and coordination of tasks

• Ensure a team environment that supports engagement, wellbeing and career development opportunities

• Develop, implement and maintain strategy and roadmap Laboratory Systems in Genmab's QC

• Ensure validation of relevant IT systems for the QC laboratory as System Owner

• Develop and manage the performance

• Serve as the primary point of contact across functional teams and external vendors

• Drive a culture of quality excellence, LEAN and continuous improvements

• Direct, guide, and monitor documentation and evolution of Standard Operating Procedures

• Support and participate in audits and regulatory agency inspections

• Ensure that QC employees comply with required safety and cGMP procedures and requirements

• Responsible for being compliant with Genmab's quality system

**Requirements

**

• It is expected that you hold a Master's degree in science or a related technical area

• Preferably 10+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry

• Strong experience working in a cGMP environment with knowledge of laboratory IT systems, QC equipment, testing, sampling and release.

• Experienced people leader

• Experience in working in cross-functional teams to accomplish shared goals

• Strong experience working in analytical and regulatory requirements

• Significant applied experience in laboratory operations, including development and adherence to quality metric programs

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK734.400,00---1.101.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

In our delivery stream we cater primarily for dental laboratories. We are building both administrative software for dental laboratories (Lab Management Software – LMS) and AI-assisted dental CAD software (Automate) for designing crowns, bridges and other types of dental restorations with a clear strategy to converge these applications and offer seamless and smooth workflows for our customers.

Our cloud infrastructure is in Microsoft Azure. Our primary coding language is C# with Blazor for front-end and Pulumi for IaC. We use GitHub Actions and PowerShell scripts for build and deployment.

You will be joining the mature LMS team of app. 10 people distributed across Copenhagen and Kyiv, Ukraine. We in the LMS team have established sound processes; working in short iterations, high degree of test automation, frequent releases, relentless addressing of incoming bugs and continuous improvement. We have a strong focus on collaboration between everyone in the team and pride ourselves in having a great team spirit of having a good time while delivering high-quality work on schedule.

Your role

In this role, you will be a hands-on member of LMS team, spending most of your time designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining product features. Alongside your development responsibilities, you will help your and other teams incorporate secure development practices into their daily work and contribute to building robust and trustworthy solutions for our customers.

We see you as a developer picking up tasks from the prioritized backlog and working as a generally capable and engaged team member. We do not expect you to be a dedicated security expert or to own security activities alone. Instead, we are looking for someone who understands how to build secure cloud applications and can help the teams make practical security decisions while continuing to deliver business value. You will proactively propagate good security practices to developers, testers and the architect in the team, and you will take pleasure in motivating and propagating these practices to other teams, e.g. through our stream architect community, where you are expected to be a guest star.

We are yearning to hear your suggestions for initiatives to increase secure coding practices, e.g. tooling, courses, breakathons and penetration tests, and we expect you to establish a good and active dialogue with our chief security architect and kindred spirits in the company. We thus expect you to be proactively outgoing; sticking your nose into things outside your team scope, but for “the right reasons”.

Success in this role comes from balancing strong engineering skills with pragmatic security thinking while remaining focused on delivering great software.

Your profile

We are looking for a senior software developer with savviness for and proven experience in building secure high-quality cloud applications. Likewise, we see that you can check most of the following boxes:

• 
Senior-level Software development competences; C# and/or C++

• 
Proven hands-on experience with building secure large cloud systems

• 
Proven hands-on experience with cloud security engineering, including container, Kubernetes, IaC and CI/CD security

• 
Experience applying security concepts such as OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and API security

• 
Experience with IaC and DevSecOps, including tool chains and security scanning pipelines

• 
Familiarity with Azure operational and governance tools, e.g. Azure Advisor Security

• 
Interest in staying informed about emerging security threats and development practices

• 
Taking ownership, seeing the big picture, and having a pragmatic approach

• 
Strong collaboration and communication skills and fluent in written and spoken English

o You are influential, but not manipulative

o You are outgoing, but maintain your focus

We offer

• 
Strong focus on professional and personal development – and budget to back it!

• 
Empowerment and challenging tasks in a successful MedTech company with cutting edge technology;

• 
An inspiring international and informal environment with committed and highly skilled colleagues – we are more than 30 nationalities in our building;

• 
Attractive office in the center of Copenhagen, next to Kongens Nytorv metro station;

• 
Healthcare package to keep you fit and well, and fresh and delicious lunch cooked by our private chef;

•

At Genmab, we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients through innovative antibody-based medicines. To support our biologics pipeline and portfolio, we are looking for a CMC Senior Stability Specialist in the CMC Stability department to strengthen our CMC organization with a focus on life-cycle-management activities.

**The Role and Department

**As CMC Senior Stability Specialist, you will be part of the CMC Stability department organized in CMC Development and Manufacturing. The CMC Stability department supports the Genmab portfolio from early CMC development projects to commercial products. Additionally, you will be part of and collaborate with CMC project teams

In the role, you will be responsible for stability, governance of products and collaborate closely with colleagues within the department, across CMC, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Supply, and with external partners at CDMO’s/CMO’s in a highly matrixed, international environment.

Besides having extended experience with biologics and stability, the ideal candidate is statistically well-founded and can help advance the department’s data-handling capabilities.

This position will report to the Head of Department, CMC Stability.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as stability subject matter expert supporting Genmab’s biologics products.

• Ensure alignment and oversight of stability activities performed at external partners, CDMO’s/CMO’s, and internal laboratories.

• Ensure scientifically sound and regulatory-compliant stability approaches aligned with ICH guidelines and regulations.

• Perform and oversee statistical evaluation of stability data, including data handling, trend analysis and shelf-life determination.

• Author and review CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, BLA/MAA, variations).

• Support health authority interactions, e.g. be part of the request for information processes for topics related to stability.

• Be part of establishing a mature life-cycle-management set-up for commercial products.

**Requirements

• PhD or MSc in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, statistics, or related discipline.

• Significant experience (typically 7+ years) within CMC stability for biologics and strong knowledge of ICH guidelines, including Q1A–Q1E, Q5C, and Q6B.

• Extensive knowledge and understanding of stability for marketed biologics/clinical biological products according to current requirements and best industrial practices.

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience in statistical methods applied to stability data (e.g. regression analysis, pooling, trend analysis).

• Experience working and interacting with CDMO’s/CMO’s.

• Experience with supporting global regulatory submissions.

• Ability to translate complex scientific and statistical data into clear regulatory and business recommendations.

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• You seek and have demonstrated ability to collaborate with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to support product development programs.

• You have a structured and analytical approach when solving problems.

• Flair for IT and user software to monitor stability.

• You can manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and define steps needed to achieve project and department goals.

• You can work successfully and with integrity in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.

**What You Can Expect At Genmab

• A collaborative and inclusive culture with strong cross-functional teamwork.

• Opportunities to shape strategy and contribute to key project decisions.

• Professional growth in a global biologics company with a strong pipeline.
